title: Spanning trees in the Assignment Problem: two theorems and two conjectures
summary: The \emph{Minimum Matching Problem} consists of finding an independent edge set of minimum weight $M_{\star}(G)$ in a given edge-weighted graph $G$. When $G$ is bipartite, this reduces to the \emph{Assignment Problem}. We consider a variant of this problem defined by taking the union of optimal matchings across various slightly modified versions of the base graph: $H_{\mathcal{J}}(G)=\bigcup_{U \in \mathcal{J}} M_{\star}(G_{U})$.
